question: Do trailing DRR depth and directed lag-correlation features improve delayed daily return forecasts and net long/cash performance beyond established baselines?

data.integrity: Verify every upstream ZIP SHA-256 against its CHECKSUM; pin normalized CSV and source manifest before evaluation.
data.missing_policy: Abort on missing, duplicate, unsorted, nonfinite or invalid OHLCV bars. No imputation, backfill, symbol replacement or date deletion.
data.vintage_limit: Historical archive downloaded now, not an original point-in-time vintage. Revisions and retrospective universe selection remain limitations.
data.license: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 and Binance Vision Dataset Terms; dataset and derived results are not covered by the code MIT license.

timing.feature_date: t denotes the UTC date of a completed daily bar; all features use only bars through t.
timing.target: O[t+3]/O[t+2]-1, a one-day simple return with one full intervening day after the feature bar closes.
timing.refit: calendar quarter; weights fixed within each quarter
timing.update_rule: At each quarter start only labels exiting strictly before the first feature date minus 7 days are eligible. Reserve the last 180 eligible rows for calibration; purge fit labels within 7 days of the first calibration feature date. Fit on the most recent 1095 eligible fit rows. Mature prior holdout labels may enter later refits, never hyperparameter selection.

features.conventional: Both assets: close-to-close returns and lags; trailing mean, sample standard deviation, cumulative momentum; log(high/low); log(close/open); log1p(volume) minus trailing 20-day mean. Trailing 20/60-day cross-asset correlation. No globally fitted transform.
features.drr_spectral: Existing DepthCalculator on each asset's last 64 close returns, window_size=32, sampling_rate=1: depth, four components and target frequency. Descriptive scores; the module's heuristic confidence interval is not used as predictive uncertainty.
features.drr_rooting: Existing RootingAnalyzer on the same 64x2 return window: both directed max-absolute lag correlations and selected lags, max_lag=3, n_surrogates=0. No causality or edge significance claim.
features.noise_control: Conventional features plus 16 independent standard normal columns, seed 20261114, generated sequentially by date so truncation leaves the prefix unchanged.

models.selection: Lowest equal-asset validation MSE, ties by listed order. One shared setting per model across both assets. Publish every trial. Ridge scaling fitted only on the fit split. Separate model per asset. No clipping or post-holdout tuning.
models.historical_mean: Mean of eligible fit targets at each refit.
models.momentum20: Trailing 20-day arithmetic mean of close returns, no fitted parameters.
models.primary_candidate: Lowest-validation-MSE candidate, locked before test scoring.
models.economic_comparator: Lowest-validation-MSE baseline, locked before test scoring.

uncertainty.method: Absolute held-out calibration residuals / trailing 20-day return volatility (floor 0.0001); finite-sample higher order statistic at ceil((n+1)*0.9). At prediction use the fitted model and current trailing volatility. No refit on calibration data.
uncertainty.limitations: These are empirical time-series prediction intervals, not distribution-free guarantees under serial dependence or regime shifts. Publish coverage, width and interval score for each asset, model, calendar year and ex-ante regime.

execution.position: Each asset has a maximum 0.5 portfolio weight. Long iff predicted simple return > 0.003; otherwise cash. No shorts, leverage or interest.
execution.accounting: Self-financing daily target-weight portfolio. Charge turnover from drifted pretrade weights, including first entry and final liquidation; solve fees against post-cost target wealth. Report gross/net growth, mean, volatility, Sharpe (sqrt(365)), drawdown, exposure, turnover and break-even proportional cost.
execution.limits: Daily open prices with hypothetical proportional costs are execution proxies. No order-book, spread, market impact, capacity, exchange failure, stablecoin depeg or fill guarantee is estimated. Fee assumptions are scenarios, not a verified account fee tier.

inference.loss: Daily cross-asset mean squared error; resample whole dates jointly across assets/models.
inference.family: 14 one-sided tests: each of 2 DRR candidates versus each of 5 baselines on MSE; each DRR candidate versus cash and the validation-selected baseline on base-cost daily net return.
inference.method: Paired circular moving-block bootstrap of daily differences, centered under the null; plus-one p-values; pointwise percentile 95% intervals. Holm step-down across the complete 14-test family.
inference.gate: The validation-selected candidate must reduce MSE by at least 1% against every baseline and reject all five loss nulls plus both economic nulls after Holm at every block length. Its stress-cost cumulative net return must be positive, its MSE must beat the validation-selected baseline in at least 2 of 3 test years, and its predictive interval coverage must be at least 85% on each asset. Otherwise report NOT SUPPORTED; missing required results means INCOMPLETE, never success.
inference.assumptions: Bootstrap inference is approximate under weak dependence and locally stable distributions; block-length and regime reports expose sensitivity but cannot eliminate nonstationarity. Correction covers this registered family, not undisclosed prior research or alternate universes.

regimes.volatility: Mean across assets of trailing 20-day return std; high iff above the 75th percentile of development-period feature dates, threshold frozen before validation/test.
regimes.trend: Mean across assets of trailing 60-day cumulative return >=0 is up, else down.
regimes.reporting: Four ex-ante vol/trend strata plus each calendar year; include every stratum and its sample size. Descriptive, not extra significance claims.

required: all validation trials and selection lock
all per-date predictions, interval bounds, targets and fit/calibration cutoffs
all 14 tests at every block length
publication.no_suppression: Write all outcomes regardless of sign or significance. Never use scientific success as CI pass criterion.
publication.prospective_limit: This is a preregistered analysis of already historical data, not a blind live trial. No claim of independence from public knowledge of 2023-2025 events. Reusing the holdout for methodological tuning invalidates confirmatory language; corrections must be logged.
